steps.npc: I knew you would save us! Bless you, my child!

steps.player: Thanks! Just stay indoors while those zombies are still prowling around.

steps.npc: May Saradomin's light shine upon you!

steps.player: Tell him to save it for when I manage to defeat those zombies!

steps.npc: Saradomin smile upon you! You've saved us all!

steps.player: All in a day's work, brother.

steps.npc: Your name will forever be listed amongst the virtuous!

steps.player: I'll remember that the next time I go drinking...
